title: Princess Eugenie reveals baby daughter’s name with touching tribute to Queen Elizabeth II
summary_full: Princess Eugenie has revealed the name of her newborn daughter with a touching tribute to the late Queen Elizabeth II. Eugenie and Jack Brooksbank have named their third child Adelaide Elizabeth Annina Brooksbank. The royal said the name honours three people they love and admire, while also reflecting their connection to England and Portugal.
